shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
row of repeated similar figures along a horizontal register
horizontal band of repeating pattern/geometric motif
justification: Both are low-relief flat slabs with profile figures arranged over a tall vertical field, and both include a horizontal band of repeating geometric pattern separating registers, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise the content is quite different: A shows large naturalistic robed human figures with beards, fringed garments and gestures of touching/greeting, while B shows schematic animals — a row of crouching quadrupeds along the top, a bird of prey, a snake-like creature and a long-necked bird — with no human figures or interaction of the kind seen in A.
